info.title: Child support by state (OCSE): collections, cases, orders and arrears, fiscal years 2021 to 2025: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Child support by state (OCSE): collections, cases, orders and arrears, fiscal years 2021 to 2025: The Office of Child Support Enforcement's preliminary data tables for the nation, every state, DC, Guam, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands, five federal fiscal years: child support collections distributed, cases open, cases with a support order, paternities established, current support due and distributed, arrears due, children in cases and OCSE's cost-effectiveness ratio. Two shares are computed from OCSE's own counts.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
